_meta.indication: SARCLISA is indicated, in combination with pomalidomide and dexamethasone, for the treatment of adult patients with multiple myeloma who have received at least two prior therapies including lenalidomide and a proteasome inhibitor.

pivotal_trials.design: Open-label, randomized, parallel-group, two-arm trial comparing Isa-Pd to Pd, randomized 1:1.
pivotal_trials.population: Adult patients with relapsed or refractory multiple myeloma who had received at least 2 prior lines of therapy including lenalidomide and a proteasome inhibitor.
pivotal_trials.endpoint: Progression-free survival (PFS) assessed by independent review committee (IRC).
pivotal_trials.result: Median PFS 11.53 months (IPd) vs 6.47 months (Pd); stratified HR 0.596 (95% CI 0.436 to 0.814). ORR 60.4% vs 35.3% (p<0.0001).

key_safety: Most common adverse reactions (≥20%) were neutropenia, infusion-related reactions (38%), pneumonia, upper respiratory tract infection, and diarrhea. Grade 3-4 neutropenia occurred in 85%. Serious adverse reactions occurred in 62%, including pneumonia (26%); fatal adverse reactions in 11%.
target_moa: Isatuximab is a CD38-directed cytolytic monoclonal antibody that acts through IgG Fc-dependent mechanisms including ADCC, ADCP, and CDC, and blocks the enzymatic activity of CD38.

advisory_committee.vote: No advisory committee was convened; the review states Not Applicable.

orphan_indication.text: Orphan drug designation granted for isatuximab (SAR650984) for the treatment of multiple myeloma on May 22, 2014.

citations.quote: May 22, 2014: Sanofi received notice that FDA granted orphan drug designation for SAR650984 for treatment of multiple myeloma.

summary.text: SARCLISA was reviewed as an original standard (non-priority) BLA with orphan drug designation for multiple myeloma; it was approved on the basis of the phase 3 ICARIA-MM (EFC14335) trial and no advisory committee was convened. It was not an accelerated approval.

Due to orphan drug designation of isatuximab for this indication, it is exempt from PREA requirements. This information was submitted in Section 1.9.1 of the BLA Application.

requirement.text: 3782-1: Conduct long term safety monitoring of patients enrolled in ICARIA to determine the incidence of acute myeloid leukemia, myelodysplastic syndrome and other second primary malignancies in patients receiving isatuximab plus pomalidomide and dexamethasone.

citations.quote: 3782-1 Conduct long term safety monitoring of patients enrolled in study (ICARIA) titled; "A Phase 3 Randomized, Open-label, Multicenter Study Comparing Isatuximab (SAR650984) in Combination With Pomalidomide and Low-Dose Dexamethasone Versus Pomalidomide and Low-Dose Dexamethasone in Patients With Refractory or Relapsed and Refractory Multiple Myeloma", to determine the incidence of acute myeloid leukemia, myelodysplastic syndrome and other second primary malignancies in patients receiving isotuximab in combination with pomalidomide and dexamethasone and it's potential to have a detrimental impact on overall

requirement.text: 3782-2: Submit the final interim report and datasets (≥40 patients) to assess frequency/severity of infusion-related reactions, interruptions, rate reductions and discontinuation during the first two infusions via the fixed-volume infusion method in patients ≥100 kg vs <100 kg.

citations.quote: 3782-2 Submit the final interim report and datasets containing at least 40 patients enrolled on studies TCD13983 VRDI Part B, TCD15484, EMN 24, and EFC15992 supplemented by data from other studies with similar premedications, if required, to assess the frequency and severity of infusion-related reactions, occurrence of intravenous infusion interruptions, infusion rate reductions, and discontinuation during the first two infusions of isotuximab administered via the fixed-volume infusion method in patients weighing \ge 100 kg compared to patients weighing <100 kg.

requirement.text: 3782-3: Submit the overall survival analysis and datasets with the final report for ICARIA to provide additional long term efficacy data that may inform product labeling.

citations.quote: 3782-3 Submit the overall survival analysis and datasets with the final report for clinical trial (ICARIA) titled; "A Phase 3 Randomized, Open-label, Multicenter Study Comparing Isatuximab (SAR650984) in Combination With Pomalidomide and Low-Dose Dexamethasone Versus Pomalidomide and Low-Dose Dexamethasone in Patients With Refractory or Relapsed and Refractory Multiple Myeloma" to provide additional long term efficacy data that may inform product labeling.

requirement.text: 3782-4: Develop a validated assay to detect interference of isatuximab with remaining endogenous M protein to facilitate determination of complete response in multiple myeloma patients.

citations.quote: 3782-4 Develop a validated assay to detect interference of isotuximab to any remaining endogenous M protein in the patient's serum, to facilitate determination of a complete response (CR) in patients with multiple myeloma. Complete and submit the final report of the validation study, that may provide information to prescribers about the use of the assay to determine CR.

requirement.text: 3782-5: Complete a real-time leachables study using the final container closure system with isatuximab drug product for each presentation.

citations.quote: 3782-5 Complete a real-time leachables study using the final container closure system with isotuximab drug product for each presentation to identify any potential leachables in final isotuximab drug product at initial, 6, 12, 24 and 36 months under storage condition between 2°C-8°C.
